
In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment
 - The most recent Claude models are the Claude 5 family. Model IDs — Fable 5.1: 'claude-fable-5-1', Opus 5.5: 'claude-opus-5-5', Sonnet 5.5: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', Haiku 5.5: 'claude-haiku-5-5'. When building AI applications, default to the latest and most capable Claude models.
 - Claude Code is available as a CLI in the terminal, desktop app (Mac/Windows), web app (claude.ai/code), and IDE extensions (VS Code, JetBrains).
 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

17	### 2.1 单目 3D 检测的本质困难：深度不确定
18	
19	一张图像是 3D 世界沿光线的投影。成像过程把三维压成二维，同一条光线上的所有点落在同一像素上——**单张图像在原理上无法唯一确定深度**。因此单目 3D 检测只能借助统计先验（类别平均尺寸、深度分布）与几何约束（相机内参）来「猜」出最合理的 3D 框。本讲会反复看到这一点的工程化身：
20	
21	- 深度用 `exp()` 解码保证为正，或用「均值 + 标准差 × 偏移」围绕数据集先验回归；
22	- 尺寸围绕每类平均尺寸回归乘性偏移；
23	- 朝向被拆成「视线角（可由已知量算出）+ 局部朝向（网络回归）」。

26

28	
29	\[(x,\ y,\ z,\ x\_size,\ y\_size,\ z\_size,\ yaw)\]
30	
31	其中 \(x\_size\) 是沿右方向的宽、\(y\_size\) 是沿下方向的高、\(z\_size\) 是沿前方向的长（见 `CameraInstance3DBoxes` 的类注释）。
32	
33	相机内参 `cam2img`（KITTI 里常叫 P2/P3）把相机系点映到像素：
34	
35	\[ u = \frac{f_x X}{Z} + c_x,\qquad v = \frac{f_y Y}{Z} + c_y \]
36	
37	两个方向都常用到（均在 [mmdet3d/structures/bbox_3d/utils.py](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/bbox_3d/utils.py#L184-L261)）：

164	### 4.2 AnchorFreeMono3DHead 公共骨架与 FCOSMono3DHead 的分组回归头
165	
166	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
167	
168	两个单目 head 都继承 `AnchorFreeMono3DHead`。这个公共骨架做的事很纯粹：**搭塔**。它在每个 FPN 层上搭若干卷积塔（tower），分别输出：
169	
170	- 分类分支：`num_classes` 通道；
171	- 回归分支：按 `group_reg_dims` **分组**输出——这是 3D 与 2D FCOS 最大的差别，2D 只回归 4 个量，3D 要回归一族语义不同的量，各组的激活函数、尺度、损失都不同，所以物理上分成多个 `1×1` 卷积；
172	- 方向分支（可选）：2 通道；
173	- 属性分支（可选，nuScenes 专用）：`num_attrs` 通道；
174	- centerness 分支（仅 FCOS3D）：1 通道。
175	
176	FCOS3D 在此之上把「每个像素预测什么」定义为一支 **9 维分组回归向量**，对应 nuScenes 相机系 9 维框 `(x, y, z, w, h, l, yaw, vx, vy)` 的训练参数化：
177	
178	| 组 | 维数 | 物理含义 | 单位/空间 |
179	|---|---|---|---|
180	| offset | 2 | 格点到投影中心的像素偏移（归一化） | 像素 / stride |
181	| depth | 1 | 投影中心的深度 | 米（log 空间） |
182	| size | 3 | 宽、高、长 | 米（log 空间） |
183	| rot | 1 | 局部朝向 | 弧度 |
184	| velo | 2 | 速度 | 米/秒 |
185	
186	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
187	
188	训练一条样本时 head 内部发生的事：
189	
190	```text
191	FPN 五层特征 (B, 256, H/8, W/8) ... (B, 256, H/128, W/128)
192	  │ forward_single（每层）
193	  │   cls塔 → cls_score (B,10,H,W)          reg塔×5组 → cat 成 bbox_pred (B,9,H,W)
194	  │   dir塔 → dir_cls_pred (B,2,H,W)        attr塔 → attr_pred (B,9,H,W)
195	  │   centerness塔 → (B,1,H,W)
196	  │   ★ bbox_coder.decode(bbox_pred, scale, stride, training, cls_score)  ← 训练也解码！
197	  ▼
198	get_targets：把 gt（含 centers_2d、depths、局部化 yaw）编码成逐像素目标
199	  │   正样本 = 落在中心采样框内 ∧ 满足该层回归范围 ∧ 距中心最近
200	  │   centerness 目标 = exp(-α · 相对距离)
201	  ▼
202	loss_by_feat：FocalLoss(cls) + SmoothL1(offset/depth/size/rotsin/velo 各组)
203	              + CE(dir) + CE(attr) + BCE(centerness)
204	```
205	
206	推理路径见 4.3.3。**特别注意** `forward_single` 里的 `bbox_coder.decode`：与「推理才解码」的常见设计不同，FCOS3D 在训练前向内就做了解码（把原始输出变换到有物理量纲的空间），损失定义在解码后的空间上——深度因此可以直接用米制 SmoothL1 监督。

263	
264	**练习 1**：`group_reg_dims` 为什么不直接设成一个数（如 9），而要拆成 `(2, 1, 3, 1, 2)`？
265	
266	**答案**：分组让每组拥有独立卷积塔、独立 `Scale`、独立损失与 `code_weight`，还可按需关闭某组的塔（velo 组 `()`）。深度、尺寸、朝向、速度的量纲与最优学习动态完全不同，物理分组是自然选择。SMOKE 则反过来用单组 8 维（见 4.4），说明这不是硬性约束而是设计权衡。
267	
268	**练习 2**：FCOS3D 的正负样本分配与 u5-l6 的 `Max3DIoUAssigner` 有何本质区别？
269	
270	**答案**：FCOS3D 无 anchor、无 IoU——每个像素按「中心采样框 ∧ 回归范围 ∧ 最近中心」三条规则直接定身份，是逐像素的几何判定；`Max3DIoUAssigner` 是 anchor 与 gt 之间按重叠阈值分配。二者都需要处理歧义（一个点/anchor 对多个 gt），FCOS3D 用最近距离，IoU 系用最大重叠。
271	
272	**练习 3**：为什么 centerness 要「挂」在回归特征上（`centerness_on_reg=True`）而不是分类特征上？
273	
274	**答案**：centerness 度量的是回归质量（离中心多远），与回归分支共享特征更合理；且源码注释引用了 FCOS 官方 issue #89 的讨论——放在回归分支上训练更稳定。这是从 2D FCOS 继承下来的实证选择。

276	### 4.3 FCOS3DBBoxCoder：深度/尺寸的指数解码与局部→全局朝向
277	
278	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
279	
280	`FCOS3DBBoxCoder` 解决单目 3D 的两个核心难题：
281	
282	1. **深度与尺寸必须为正且有合理量级**。网络裸输出是无界实数，直接当米数用会出负深度。解法：在 log 空间回归、解码时取指数——
283	
284	\[ d = e^{o_d},\qquad (w, h, l) = e^{o_s} \]
285	
286	log 空间中均匀的预测误差对应物理空间的**相对**误差，这对跨度大（几米到几十米）的量比线性回归更友好。若数据集统计了深度/尺寸先验（`base_depths`/`base_dims`），则改为围绕先验的线性回归 \(d = \mu + \sigma \cdot o_d\)，进一步缩小网络需要覆盖的输出范围。
287	
288	2. **朝向与视角耦合**。相机系全局 yaw 同时依赖物体自身朝向和它出现在视野哪个方位（同一辆车在画面左侧和正前方，全局 yaw 差别很大）。解法：把全局 yaw 分解为
289	
290	\[ yaw_{global} = \underbrace{\arctan\frac{u - c_x}{f_x}}_{\text{视线角，由内参与像素位置算出}} + \; yaw_{local} \]
291	
292	网络只回归与位置无关的局部 yaw，视线角在解码时精确补上（由 \(u - c_x = f_x X / Z\) 可证 \(\arctan\frac{u-c_x}{f_x} = \arctan\frac{X}{Z}\)，与 4.2.3 的目标编码严格互逆）。
293	
294	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
295	
296	`decode`（前向内调用，逐层）：
297	
298	```text
299	raw (B,9,H,W)
300	  ├─ offset × scale₀、depth × scale₁、size × scale₂     # 可学习尺度（3 组）
301	  ├─ depth: exp(o)                       # 无先验时
302	  │        或 μ + σ·o                     # base_depths 单先验
303	  │        或 μ_c + σ_c·o                 # 多类先验，按 cls_score argmax 选类
304	  ├─ size: exp(o)（可再乘每类 base_dims）
305	  └─ 训练时 offset 不乘 stride；推理时 offset × stride    # 与 target 的 /stride 配对
306	```
307	
308	`decode_yaw`（仅推理、合层后调用）：
309	
310	```text
311	local yaw（标量）+ dir 二分类
312	  → limit_period 折叠到 (-π/2, π/2] 并按 dir 补 π        # 解决头尾歧义
313	  → + atan2(u - c_x, f_x)                                # 补视线角成全局 yaw
314	```

351	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
352	
353	**练习 1**：为什么深度用 `exp` 解码而不是直接线性回归米数？
354	
355	**答案**：保证严格为正；且 log 空间的常数误差对应物理空间的固定**相对**误差（\(d = e^o \Rightarrow \delta d / d = \delta o\)），对「近处 5 米、远处 60 米」跨两个数量级的回归目标，比线性空间的绝对误差更合理。有可靠先验（`base_depths`）时退化为先验附近的线性回归，二者不矛盾——先验负责定标，网络负责修正。
356	
357	**练习 2**：`norm_on_bbox` 在 target 侧（÷stride）与 decode 侧（仅推理 ×stride）为什么必须这样错开？
358	
359	**答案**：训练时预测与目标要同空间比较：目标除了 stride，预测就不乘 stride，二者都在「归一化像素」空间算损失；推理时没有 target，解码必须把归一化 offset 还原成真像素偏移才能与格点坐标相加减。若两侧同时乘/除，损失空间与推理空间会错位一个 stride 因子。
360	
361	**练习 3**：视线角公式为什么用 \(\arctan\frac{u-c_x}{f_x}\) 而不直接用 \(\arctan\frac{X}{Z}\)？
362	
363	**答案**：推理时只有像素坐标与内参可用，\((X, Z)\) 尚未求出。由针孔模型 \(u - c_x = f_x X / Z\) 知两者恒等，故用像素域可直接计算的版本；训练编码（[fcos_mono3d_head.py:L873-L874](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/fcos_mono3d_head.py#L873-L874) 用 \(\arctan(X/Z)\)、解码用像素版）恰好构成互逆变换。

365	### 4.4 SMOKEMono3DHead：热图范式与 SMOKECoder
366	
367	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
368	
369	SMOKE 走 CenterNet 路线：不再让每个像素都出完整预测，而是
370	
371	- **分类即定位**：网络输出 \((B, num\_classes, H/4, W/4)\) 的中心热图，物体的投影 3D 中心在其类别通道上是一个经高斯溅射的亮斑；
372	- **回归只在中心学**：一张 8 通道回归图，只在热图峰值位置被读取。
373	
374	其 8 维回归布局与 FCOS3D 的 9 维不同，且深度放在第 0 维：
375	
376	| 通道 | 维数 | 物理含义 |
377	|---|---|---|
378	| 0 | 1 | 深度偏移（围绕先验） |
379	| 1–2 | 2 | 投影中心的像素偏移 |
380	| 3–5 | 3 | 尺寸偏移（log 空间，围绕类别均值） |
381	| 6–7 | 2 | 局部朝向的单位向量（sin, cos 二维） |
382	
383	与 FCOS3D 的对照：朝向从「标量 + 方向二分类」变成「二维单位向量」；无 centerness、无方向分类、无属性；特征只用 DLA neck 的一层 4 倍下采样图（无 FPN 多层）。
384	
385	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
386	
387	训练：
388	
389	```text
390	DLANet → DLANeck → 单层 64 通道特征 (B, 64, H/4, W/4)
391	  │ forward_single：cls热图分支 / 8通道回归分支
392	  │   cls: sigmoid + clamp(1e-4, 1-1e-4)          ← 激活内嵌在前向里
393	  │   dim 通道: sigmoid() - 0.5                   ← 尺寸偏移对称化
394	  │   ori 通道: F.normalize                        ← 单位向量
395	  ▼
396	get_targets：gt 投影中心 ×(1/4) 溅射到热图（半径由 2D 框缩放后的高斯半径决定）
397	get_predictions：在 gt 中心位置 gather 回归 → SMOKECoder.decode → 三组「半真半预测」框
398	loss：GaussianFocalLoss(热图) + L1(三组框的 8 个角点)
399	```
400	
401	推理：
402	
403	```text
404	热图 → 3×3 局部极大值 → topK=100 峰值
405	  → 峰值处 gather 8 维回归 → SMOKECoder.decode（反 trans_mat + 乘深度 + 反内参）
406	  → score > 0.25 过滤 → CameraInstance3DBoxes(origin=(0.5,0.5,0.5))
407	（无 NMS：局部极大值 + 每峰一框天然去重）
408	```

430	SMOKECoder 的解码几何：
431	
432	[mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py:L96-L112](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L96-L112) —— `decode` 把 8 维切成 depth/offset/dim/ori 四段，依次得到深度、投影中心、尺寸、朝向。
433	
434	[mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py:L114-L119](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L114-L119) —— 深度线性反归一：\(d = o_d \times 16.32 + 28.01\)，即配置里那对先验。
435	
436	[mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py:L148-L161](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L148-L161) —— 求中心的解析反投影：特征图点加偏移 → 齐次坐标左乘 `trans_mat` 的逆回到原图像素 → **乘上深度**（把归一化坐标变成 \( (u d, v d, d) \)）→ 左乘 `cam2img` 的逆 → 相机系 3D 中心。这与 4.3.4 手推的几何完全同构，只是多了「特征图 ↔ 原图」的仿射一层。
437	
438	[mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py:L163-L177](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L163-L177) —— 尺寸：\(dims = e^{o} \cdot \bar{dims}_{label}\)，乘性围绕类别均值。[L179-L217](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L179-L217) —— 朝向：由单位向量算夹角 \(\alpha = \arctan(\sin/(\cos+\epsilon))\)，按 cos 分量符号做 ±π/2 象限修正，再加视线角 \(ray = \arctan(X/Z)\)（用刚解出的中心位置）得全局 yaw，最后折叠回 \([-\pi, \pi]\)——与 FCOS3D 的 `decode_yaw` 目的相同，但用二维向量替代「标量 + 二分类」。
439	
440	训练侧的三组 corner 损失：
441	
442	[mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py:L302-L323](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L302-L323) —— `get_predictions` 在 **gt 投影中心**处 gather 回归预测并解码；L309 `locations[:, 1] += dimensions[:, 1] / 2` 把几何中心换到底面中心（配合 `encode` 用 `box_type_3d` 默认底面 origin 包装）；L316-321 构造三组「替换一个成分、其余用真值」的框——预测朝向的 `bbox3d_yaws`、预测尺寸的 `bbox3d_dims`、预测位置的 `bbox3d_locs`。
443	
444	[mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py:L533-L552](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L533-L552) —— 损失 = GaussianFocalLoss（热图）+ 三组框各自 `.corners`（每框 8 个三维角点）对真值角点的 L1 之和。用角点而非裸参数算损失，是把「位置、尺寸、朝向」三个异质量纲的误差统一到同一几何空间的手法（u6-l4 Part-A2 的 corner loss 同源）。另注意 [L385-L389](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L385-L389)：经历过 `RandomShiftScale` 仿射增强（`affine_aug=True`）的样本不计回归损失——2D 仿射后 3D 真值不再可靠，只保留热图监督。
445	
446	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
447	
448	**实践目标**：理解 SMOKE 先验的量级意义。
449	
450	**操作步骤**（纸面 + 阅读型实践）：
451	
452	1. 读 [configs/_base_/models/smoke.py:L46-L51](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/configs/_base_/models/smoke.py#L46-L51)，记下 `base_depth=(28.01, 16.32)` 与三组 `base_dims`；
453	2. 假设网络对某峰值点输出深度偏移 \(o_d = 0.5\)、尺寸偏移 \((0.1, -0.1, 0)\)，类别为 Car（`base_dims` 第 3 组 \((3.88, 1.63, 1.53)\)）；
454	3. 用 `_decode_depth`（L114-119）与 `_decode_dimension`（L163-177）的公式手算深度与尺寸。
455	
456	**需要观察的现象**：深度 \(= 0.5 \times 16.32 + 28.01 = 36.17\) 米；尺寸 \(= (e^{0.1} \cdot 3.88,\ e^{-0.1} \cdot 1.63,\ 1.53) \approx (4.29,\ 1.48,\ 1.53)\)。
457	
458	**预期结果**：偏移量在 ±0.5 量级即可覆盖 20~36 米的常见深度区间——先验把网络输出范围压缩到小数值区间，训练更稳定。若把 `base_depth` 改成远不适配数据集的值（如 `(5, 1)`），多数目标都需要网络输出很大的偏移才能纠偏，收敛会显著变慢（待本地验证：可在小数据集上对比训练前几百个 iter 的 loss 曲线）。
459	
460	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
461	
462	**练习 1**：SMOKE 推理为什么可以不做 NMS？
463	
464	**答案**：检出方式是热图上的 3×3 局部极大值 + 每峰只取一个框：同一物体的邻域像素在局部极大值筛选后只剩峰值本身，不同物体峰不重合，天然互斥。FCOS3D 每个像素都出框，邻域像素对同一物体的预测高度冗余，必须用旋转 NMS 去重。
465	
466	**练习 2**：SMOKE 的朝向为什么用二维单位向量，而不是 FCOS3D 的「标量 + 方向二分类」？
467	
468	**答案**：二维 \((\sin, \cos)\) 表示天然消除了 \(2\pi\) 周期与 ±π 不连续问题（角度回绕在单位圆上连续），不需要额外的方向分类分支；代价是解码时要处理象限（`_decode_orientation` 的 ±π/2 修正）。两种方案解决同一个问题，是同一权衡的不同取舍——u5-l7 的 MultiBin、u5-l4 的 sin 差回归也都是这个家族的成员。
469	
470	**练习 3**：`trans_mat` 在 SMOKE 里必不可少，在 FCOS3D 里却没有，为什么？
471	
472	**答案**：SMOKE 的管线含 `RandomShiftScale`/`AffineResize` 仿射增强，特征图坐标与原图像素之间隔着一张仿射矩阵，解码时必须先乘 `trans_mat` 逆还原；FCOS3D 的测试管线只有 `mmdet.Resize`（等比缩放，比例信息在 `scale_factor` 里，见 [fcos_mono3d_head.py:L658-L659](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/fcos_mono3d_head.py#L658-L659) 的处理），不需要完整仿射矩阵。解码器与数据管线是配套设计的。
473	
474	## 5. 综合实践
475	
476	**任务**：按本讲规格完成——「用 FCOS3D config 实例化 head，随机图像特征 forward，打印每个输出分支张量形状，并把 bbox_coder 的解码输出投影回图像平面验证 2D 框合理性」。
477	
478	**实践目标**：把 4.2 的分支结构、4.3 的解码几何在本机跑通，亲手验证「解码 → 反投影 → 再投影」的往返一致性。
479	
480	**操作步骤**：
481	
482	1. 准备脚本（示例代码，保存为 `fcos3d_head_probe.py`，在仓库根目录运行）：
483	
484	```python
485	# 示例代码：探针 FCOSMono3DHead 的分支形状与解码几何
486	import torch
487	from mmengine import Config, init_default_scope
488	
489	init_default_scope('mmdet3d')          # 让 type='FCOSMono3DHead' 能路由（u4-l1）
490	from mmdet3d.registry import MODELS    # locations 懒导入会自动加载 mmdet3d.models
491	from mmdet3d.structures import points_cam2img, points_img2cam
492	
493	cfg = Config.fromfile(
494	    'configs/fcos3d/fcos3d_r101-caffe-dcn_fpn_head-gn_8xb2-1x_nus-mono3d.py')
495	
496	head = MODELS.build(cfg.model.bbox_head)
497	head.eval()
498	
499	# 模拟 1600x900 输入（pad 到 32 的倍数）经 FPN 后的 5 层特征
500	sizes = (113, 57, 29, 15, 8)   # strides = [8, 16, 32, 64, 128]
501	feats = tuple(torch.randn(1, 256, h, w) for h, w in
502	              zip(sizes, sizes))  # 方形仅为演示
503	
504	with torch.no_grad():
505	    outs = head(feats)
506	cls_scores, bbox_preds, dir_preds, attr_preds, centernesses = outs[:5]
507	
508	print('分支形状（每层）:')
509	for name, o in zip(['cls(10)', 'bbox(9)', 'dir(2)', 'attr(9)', 'centerness(1)'],
510	                   [cls_scores, bbox_preds, dir_preds, attr_preds, centernesses]):
511	    print(f'  {name:>14}: {[tuple(t.shape) for t in o]}')
512	
513	# ---- 解码几何：取第 0 层（stride=8）某格点 ----
514	level, stride = 0, head.strides[level]
515	bbox = bbox_preds[level][0]        # (9, H, W)，forward 内已做过 decode
516	i, j = sizes[level] // 2, sizes[level] // 2   # 中心格点
517	
518	offset = bbox[:2, i, j]            # 已乘 stride 的像素偏移（eval 模式）
519	depth  = bbox[2, i, j]             # exp 后的米制深度
520	w, h, l = bbox[3:6, i, j]          # exp 后的米制尺寸（CAM 系: 宽/高/长）
521	
522	# 格点中心像素坐标（对照 _get_points_single 的公式）
523	pt = torch.tensor([j * stride + stride // 2, i * stride + stride // 2],
524	                  dtype=torch.float32)
525	center2d = pt - offset             # 投影 3D 中心的像素坐标 (u, v)
526	p25d = torch.cat([center2d, depth[None]])       # (u, v, d)
527	
528	# 2.5D → 相机系 → 再投影回像素（往返验证）
529	cam_pt = points_img2cam(p25d[None, :])[0]       # (X, Y, Z)
530	reproj = points_cam2img(cam_pt[None, :])[0]     # (u', v')
531	
532	# 内参（量级取自 nuScenes CAM_FRONT0）
533	view = torch.tensor([[1266.4, 0, 816.2], [0, 870.2, 493.9], [0, 0, 1]])
534	
535	print(f'\ndepth={depth:.2f} m, dims(w,h,l)=({w:.2f},{h:.2f},{l:.2f}) m')
536	print(f'center2d={center2d.tolist()}, cam={cam_pt.tolist()}')
537	print(f'往返误差: {float((reproj - center2d).abs().max()):.2e} px')
538	
539	# 2D 框合理性：像素宽 ≈ fx*w/Z，像素高 ≈ fy*h/Z
540	fx, fy = view[0, 0], view[1, 1]
541	print(f'投影 2D 框尺寸估计: 宽 {float(fx*w/cam_pt[2]):.1f} px, '
542	      f'高 {float(fy*h/cam_pt[2]):.1f} px')
543	```
544	
545	2. 确认环境里已按 [u1-l2](u1-l2-installation-and-verification.md) 装好 mmengine/mmcv/mmdet/mmdet3d，然后运行 `python fcos3d_head_probe.py`。
546	
547	**需要观察的现象**：
548	
549	1. 五个分支每层形状分别为 `(1, 10, H, W)`、`(1, 9, H, W)`、`(1, 2, H, W)`、`(1, 9, H, W)`、`(1, 1, H, W)`——与 4.2.4 的纸面表格逐一对上；`bbox_pred` 已是**解码后**的量（深度为正的米制值）。
550	2. 往返误差 `reproj - center2d` 应在浮点精度量级（约 1e-3 ~ 1e-5 像素），验证 `points_img2cam`/`points_cam2img` 互逆。
551	3. 随机权重下深度/尺寸是无意义的正数，投影 2D 框尺寸可能偏离常识量级（正常训练后的模型应落在几十~几百像素）。
552	
553	**预期结果**：形状表与往返误差两条可稳定复现（待本地验证：本讲义未实际执行该脚本，且 `sizes` 需与真实 FPN 输出一致——真实输入若为 1600×900，各层为 113/57/29/15/8 附近，取决于 pad；若报形状断言错误，请先用 `head.backbone` 之外的真实模型 `extract_feat` 打印实际尺寸后替换）。若想看有意义的解码值，可下载 FCOS3D 权重（见 `configs/fcos3d/README.md`）用 `init_model` 加载后再取 head 输出。
554	
555	**延伸（可选）**：把脚本中 `cfg.model.bbox_head` 换成 `Config.fromfile('configs/_base_/models/smoke.py').model.bbox_head`，feats 换成单个 `(1, 64, 96, 320)` 张量（1280×384 的 1/4），观察 SMOKE head 的 `forward` 只返回 `(cls, bbox)` 两个列表——两套 head 的分支差异一目了然（待本地验证）。
556	
557	## 6. 本讲小结
558	
559	- **检测器极薄，算法在 head**：`SingleStageMono3DDetector` 跨库继承 mmdet 的 `SingleStageDetector`，只补「从 `imgs` 取特征」与「写 `pred_instances_3d`/`pred_instances` 双契约」两件事；`SMOKEMono3D` 连 `predict` 都不重写，`FCOSMono3D` 重写它是为了装 3D/2D 双结果。
560	- **FCOS3D = 逐像素 + 分组回归**：9 维回归按 `group_reg_dims=(2,1,3,1,2)` 拆成 offset/depth/size/rot/velo 五组，各有独立卷积塔、Scale 与损失；正负样本由「中心采样 ∧ 回归范围 ∧ 最近中心」三条件逐像素判定，无 anchor、无 IoU 分配。
561	- **解码内嵌前向**：`FCOS3DBBoxCoder.decode` 在训练时也执行，深度/尺寸用 `exp`（或先验线性）保证正量纲，`norm_on_bbox` 让 offset 在「训练÷stride / 推理×stride」的配对中保持损失与推理空间一致。
562	- **朝向分解是单目的通用技巧**：全局 yaw = 视线角（由 `atan2(u-c_x, f_x)` 精确算出）+ 局部朝向（网络回归）；FCOS3D 用「标量 + 方向二分类」，SMOKE 用「二维单位向量 + 象限修正」。
563	- **SMOKE = 热图 + 解析反投影**：类别热图局部极大值 + topK 检出、无需 NMS；`SMOKECoder` 用 `trans_mat` 逆与内参逆把「像素 + 深度」解析地反投影成相机系中心，训练用三组「半真半预测」框的角点 L1。
564	- **数据管线与解码器配套**：FCOS3D 靠 `centers_2d`/`depths`（`with_bbox_depth=True`）编码目标，SMOKE 靠 `AffineResize` 写入的 `trans_mat` 还原仿射——换 head 必须同步换管线。
565	
566	## 7. 下一步学习建议
567	
568	本讲补完了「点云 / 单目 / 多模态」三条输入路线中的第二条。建议下一步：
569	
570	1. **学 [u6-l6](u6-l6-mvxnet-multimodal.md)（MVXNet 与多模态融合）**：看图像特征如何被映射回体素与点云特征融合，本讲的 `transformation_3d_flow` 逆变换知识（u3-l6）与 mmdet 组件复用（本讲 4.1）都会在那里再次出现。
571	2. **横向对比热图范式**：回看 [u5-l5](u5-l5-centerpoint.md) 的 CenterPoint，与本讲 SMOKE 对照——同一套高斯溅射/局部极大值代码资产分别在 BEV 网格与图像平面上的实例化。
572	3. **源码延伸阅读**：`mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/` 下还有 `pgd_head.py`（PGD，把深度改成概率分布预测，是 FCOS3D 的直接后继）与 `monoflex_head.py`（MonoFlex），可作为检验本讲知识迁移能力的自测材料；配套配置在 `configs/pgd/` 与 `configs/monoflex/`。
573	4. **动手验证**：完成第 5 节综合实践后，尝试把探针脚本改成加载真实权重的端到端推理（参照 [u1-l3](u1-l3-first-inference-demo.md) 的 `mono_det_demo.py` 与 `mmdet3d/apis/inference.py`），观察真实模型的深度/尺寸分布与随机权重的差别。

# 单目 3D 检测：FCOS3D、SMOKE 与相机坐标系

## 1. 本讲目标

前面几个单元里，我们看到的检测器要么吃点云（VoteNet、PointNet++ 系），要么吃「点云 + 图像」（MVXNet）。本讲进入第三条输入路线：**只有一张 2D 图像，却要输出 3D 框**——单目 3D 检测（monocular 3D detection）。

读完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `SingleStageMono3DDetector` 如何跨库继承 MMDetection 的 `SingleStageDetector`，以及单目检测器为什么可以这样「薄」。
2. 读懂 `FCOSMono3DHead` 的逐像素分组回归设计：9 维回归向量如何拆成 offset/depth/size/rot/velo 五组，训练目标如何从 `centers_2d` 与 `depths` 编码出来。
3. 读懂 `FCOS3DBBoxCoder` 的两个关键设计：深度/尺寸的指数解码与先验，以及「局部朝向 → 全局朝向」的视线角修正。
4. 对比 `SMOKEMono3DHead` 的另一种范式：关键点热图 + 8 维回归，以及 `SMOKECoder` 的解析反投影。
5. 独立完成一个实践：实例化 FCOS3D head、用随机特征跑 forward、打印每个分支的张量形状，并把 bbox_coder 的解码结果反投影回图像平面验证 2D 框合理性。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 单目 3D 检测的本质困难：深度不确定

一张图像是 3D 世界沿光线的投影。成像过程把三维压成二维，同一条光线上的所有点落在同一像素上——**单张图像在原理上无法唯一确定深度**。因此单目 3D 检测只能借助统计先验（类别平均尺寸、深度分布）与几何约束（相机内参）来「猜」出最合理的 3D 框。本讲会反复看到这一点的工程化身：

- 深度用 `exp()` 解码保证为正，或用「均值 + 标准差 × 偏移」围绕数据集先验回归；
- 尺寸围绕每类平均尺寸回归乘性偏移；
- 朝向被拆成「视线角（可由已知量算出）+ 局部朝向（网络回归）」。

### 2.2 相机坐标系与 cam2img 回顾

承接 [u2-l1](u2-l1-coordinate-systems.md)：CAM 坐标系 \(z\) 朝前、\(x\) 朝右、\(y\) 朝下，yaw 绕 \(y\) 轴。相机系 3D 框每行是

\[(x,\ y,\ z,\ x\_size,\ y\_size,\ z\_size,\ yaw)\]

其中 \(x\_size\) 是沿右方向的宽、\(y\_size\) 是沿下方向的高、\(z\_size\) 是沿前方向的长（见 `CameraInstance3DBoxes` 的类注释）。

相机内参 `cam2img`（KITTI 里常叫 P2/P3）把相机系点映到像素：

\[ u = \frac{f_x X}{Z} + c_x,\qquad v = \frac{f_y Y}{Z} + c_y \]

两个方向都常用到（均在 [mmdet3d/structures/bbox_3d/utils.py](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/structures/bbox_3d/utils.py#L184-L261)）：

- `points_cam2img`：3D → 像素（齐次坐标乘投影矩阵后除以深度）；
- `points_img2cam`：像素 + 深度（2.5D 点 \((u, v, d)\)）→ 相机系 3D 点，即「乘上深度再乘内参逆」。

单目 3D head 的解码核心就是 `points_img2cam`：网络预测像素偏移 + 深度，先拼出投影中心的 2.5D 坐标，再反投影回相机系。

### 2.3 两种 2D 检测范式：逐像素 vs 关键点热图

本讲的两个 head 正好是 2D 检测两大 anchor-free 范式的 3D 化：

| 范式 | 2D 代表 | 3D 化代表 | 检出方式 | 后处理 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 逐像素回归 | FCOS | FCOS3D | 每个特征像素都输出一组预测 | 逐层 topK + 旋转 NMS |
| 关键点热图 | CenterNet | SMOKE | 类别热图上取局部极大值 | topK + 阈值过滤（无 NMS） |

回忆 [u5-l5](u5-l5-centerpoint.md) 的 CenterPoint：它也是热图范式，只是画在 BEV 网格上；SMOKE 把同一思想搬到了图像平面。

### 2.4 单目 3D 的数据契约

承接 [u3-l5](u3-l5-loading-transforms.md) 与 [u3-l8](u3-l8-pack3d-det-inputs.md)。单目管线的两个特殊约定：

- `LoadImageFromFileMono3D` 加载图像并从 info 中取出 `cam2img` 等标定；
- `LoadAnnotations3D(..., with_bbox_depth=True)` 会额外产出 `centers_2d`（3D 框几何中心在图像上的投影，单位像素）和 `depths`（该中心的深度，单位米）。

FCOS3D 的 `Pack3DDetInputs` keys 里明确包含这两个键（见配置引用），它们最终出现在 `gt_instances_3d` 里，成为训练目标的原料。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 SingleStageMono3DDetector：跨库继承的单目检测器骨架

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

单目 3D 检测的输入是图像、主干是 2D CNN、特征金字塔是 FPN——这与 MMDetection 的 2D 检测完全同构。既然如此，mmdet3d 没有重造一遍「backbone → neck → dense head」的训练循环，而是**直接跨库继承 mmdet 的一阶段检测器**，只补上 3D 特有的两件事：

1. 从 mmdet3d 的 `batch_inputs_dict`（含 `imgs` 键）中取图；
2. 把 head 的输出同时写成 `Det3DDataSample` 的 `pred_instances_3d` 与 `pred_instances` 双契约（承接 [u2-l4](u2-l4-det3d-data-sample.md)）。

回忆 [u4-l2](u4-l2-detector-class-hierarchy.md) 讲过的 mmdet3d 自有 `SingleStage3DDetector`（面向点云）：单目分支**不走**那条线，而是挂在 mmdet 的 2D 体系上。这是「配置中 `mmdet.` 前缀跨库借用」在类继承层面的对应物——代码层面用 `from mmdet.models.detectors.single_stage import SingleStageDetector` 直接 import。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

以 FCOS3D 为例的一次完整前向：

```text
Det3DDataPreprocessor（mean/std、bgr_to_rgb、pad 32）   ← u4-l3 已讲
        │  batch_inputs_dict['imgs']: (B, 3, H, W)
        ▼
SingleStageMono3DDetector.extract_feat
        │  mmdet.ResNet → mmdet.FPN（5 层，strides 8/16/32/64/128）
        ▼
FCOSMono3DHead.loss / .predict（由 mmdet SingleStageDetector 的
        │   train_step/test_step 模板调用，BaseMono3DDenseHead 拆 data_samples）
        ▼
add_pred_to_datasample → Det3DDataSample.pred_instances_3d / pred_instances
```

训练（`loss`）流程完全继承 mmdet，不需要任何重写；推理（`predict`）由 `FCOSMono3D` 重写，因为 head 返回的是 `(3D 结果, 2D 结果)` 二元组，而 mmdet 模板只预期单列表。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `SingleStageMono3DDetector` 继承 mmdet 的 `SingleStageDetector`，而不是 mmdet3d 自己的 `SingleStage3DDetector`？

**答案**：`SingleStage3DDetector`（u4-l2）面向点云输入，其 `extract_feat`/数据通路围绕 `batch_inputs_dict['points']` 设计；单目输入是图像张量 `imgs`，与 2D 检测同构，直接复用 mmdet 的一阶段模板（backbone/neck/loss 循环）改造成本最低。这也呼应 u1-l4 的方法：带 `mmdet.` 前缀或直接 import mmdet 的组件，都是跨库借用的 2D 资产。

**练习 2**：`add_pred_to_datasample` 为什么要把缺失的一侧补成空 `InstanceData`，而不是留空不写？

**答案**：`Det3DDataSample` 是全流程统一契约（u2-l4）。下游（Evaluator、Visualizer、Inferencer）按固定字段名读取 `pred_instances_3d` / `pred_instances`；只输出 3D 的模型若不写 `pred_instances`，下游读取时行为不一致。补空对象保证字段总是存在且类型可预期。

**练习 3**：`aug_test` 为什么是 `pass`？这对用户意味着什么？

**答案**：源码标注 TODO，单目 3D 的 TTA 尚未实现。用户若在配置里给单目模型开 TTA（多增强合并，见 u7-l4 的 `MultiViewWrapper`）将得不到结果，需自行实现或改用单尺度测试。

### 4.2 AnchorFreeMono3DHead 公共骨架与 FCOSMono3DHead 的分组回归头

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

两个单目 head 都继承 `AnchorFreeMono3DHead`。这个公共骨架做的事很纯粹：**搭塔**。它在每个 FPN 层上搭若干卷积塔（tower），分别输出：

- 分类分支：`num_classes` 通道；
- 回归分支：按 `group_reg_dims` **分组**输出——这是 3D 与 2D FCOS 最大的差别，2D 只回归 4 个量，3D 要回归一族语义不同的量，各组的激活函数、尺度、损失都不同，所以物理上分成多个 `1×1` 卷积；
- 方向分支（可选）：2 通道；
- 属性分支（可选，nuScenes 专用）：`num_attrs` 通道；
- centerness 分支（仅 FCOS3D）：1 通道。

FCOS3D 在此之上把「每个像素预测什么」定义为一支 **9 维分组回归向量**，对应 nuScenes 相机系 9 维框 `(x, y, z, w, h, l, yaw, vx, vy)` 的训练参数化：

| 组 | 维数 | 物理含义 | 单位/空间 |
|---|---|---|---|
| offset | 2 | 格点到投影中心的像素偏移（归一化） | 像素 / stride |
| depth | 1 | 投影中心的深度 | 米（log 空间） |
| size | 3 | 宽、高、长 | 米（log 空间） |
| rot | 1 | 局部朝向 | 弧度 |
| velo | 2 | 速度 | 米/秒 |

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

训练一条样本时 head 内部发生的事：

```text
FPN 五层特征 (B, 256, H/8, W/8) ... (B, 256, H/128, W/128)
  │ forward_single（每层）
  │   cls塔 → cls_score (B,10,H,W)          reg塔×5组 → cat 成 bbox_pred (B,9,H,W)
  │   dir塔 → dir_cls_pred (B,2,H,W)        attr塔 → attr_pred (B,9,H,W)
  │   centerness塔 → (B,1,H,W)
  │   ★ bbox_coder.decode(bbox_pred, scale, stride, training, cls_score)  ← 训练也解码！
  ▼
get_targets：把 gt（含 centers_2d、depths、局部化 yaw）编码成逐像素目标
  │   正样本 = 落在中心采样框内 ∧ 满足该层回归范围 ∧ 距中心最近
  │   centerness 目标 = exp(-α · 相对距离)
  ▼
loss_by_feat：FocalLoss(cls) + SmoothL1(offset/depth/size/rotsin/velo 各组)
              + CE(dir) + CE(attr) + BCE(centerness)
```

推理路径见 4.3.3。**特别注意** `forward_single` 里的 `bbox_coder.decode`：与「推理才解码」的常见设计不同，FCOS3D 在训练前向内就做了解码（把原始输出变换到有物理量纲的空间），损失定义在解码后的空间上——深度因此可以直接用米制 SmoothL1 监督。

### 4.3 FCOS3DBBoxCoder：深度/尺寸的指数解码与局部→全局朝向

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`FCOS3DBBoxCoder` 解决单目 3D 的两个核心难题：

1. **深度与尺寸必须为正且有合理量级**。网络裸输出是无界实数，直接当米数用会出负深度。解法：在 log 空间回归、解码时取指数——

\[ d = e^{o_d},\qquad (w, h, l) = e^{o_s} \]

log 空间中均匀的预测误差对应物理空间的**相对**误差，这对跨度大（几米到几十米）的量比线性回归更友好。若数据集统计了深度/尺寸先验（`base_depths`/`base_dims`），则改为围绕先验的线性回归 \(d = \mu + \sigma \cdot o_d\)，进一步缩小网络需要覆盖的输出范围。

2. **朝向与视角耦合**。相机系全局 yaw 同时依赖物体自身朝向和它出现在视野哪个方位（同一辆车在画面左侧和正前方，全局 yaw 差别很大）。解法：把全局 yaw 分解为

\[ yaw_{global} = \underbrace{\arctan\frac{u - c_x}{f_x}}_{\text{视线角，由内参与像素位置算出}} + \; yaw_{local} \]

网络只回归与位置无关的局部 yaw，视线角在解码时精确补上（由 \(u - c_x = f_x X / Z\) 可证 \(\arctan\frac{u-c_x}{f_x} = \arctan\frac{X}{Z}\)，与 4.2.3 的目标编码严格互逆）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`decode`（前向内调用，逐层）：

```text
raw (B,9,H,W)
  ├─ offset × scale₀、depth × scale₁、size × scale₂     # 可学习尺度（3 组）
  ├─ depth: exp(o)                       # 无先验时
  │        或 μ + σ·o                     # base_depths 单先验
  │        或 μ_c + σ_c·o                 # 多类先验，按 cls_score argmax 选类
  ├─ size: exp(o)（可再乘每类 base_dims）
  └─ 训练时 offset 不乘 stride；推理时 offset × stride    # 与 target 的 /stride 配对
```

`decode_yaw`（仅推理、合层后调用）：

```text
local yaw（标量）+ dir 二分类
  → limit_period 折叠到 (-π/2, π/2] 并按 dir 补 π        # 解决头尾歧义
  → + atan2(u - c_x, f_x)                                # 补视线角成全局 yaw
```

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么深度用 `exp` 解码而不是直接线性回归米数？

**答案**：保证严格为正；且 log 空间的常数误差对应物理空间的固定**相对**误差（\(d = e^o \Rightarrow \delta d / d = \delta o\)），对「近处 5 米、远处 60 米」跨两个数量级的回归目标，比线性空间的绝对误差更合理。有可靠先验（`base_depths`）时退化为先验附近的线性回归，二者不矛盾——先验负责定标，网络负责修正。

**练习 2**：`norm_on_bbox` 在 target 侧（÷stride）与 decode 侧（仅推理 ×stride）为什么必须这样错开？

**答案**：训练时预测与目标要同空间比较：目标除了 stride，预测就不乘 stride，二者都在「归一化像素」空间算损失；推理时没有 target，解码必须把归一化 offset 还原成真像素偏移才能与格点坐标相加减。若两侧同时乘/除，损失空间与推理空间会错位一个 stride 因子。

**练习 3**：视线角公式为什么用 \(\arctan\frac{u-c_x}{f_x}\) 而不直接用 \(\arctan\frac{X}{Z}\)？

**答案**：推理时只有像素坐标与内参可用，\((X, Z)\) 尚未求出。由针孔模型 \(u - c_x = f_x X / Z\) 知两者恒等，故用像素域可直接计算的版本；训练编码（[fcos_mono3d_head.py:L873-L874](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/fcos_mono3d_head.py#L873-L874) 用 \(\arctan(X/Z)\)、解码用像素版）恰好构成互逆变换。

### 4.4 SMOKEMono3DHead：热图范式与 SMOKECoder

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

SMOKE 走 CenterNet 路线：不再让每个像素都出完整预测，而是

- **分类即定位**：网络输出 \((B, num\_classes, H/4, W/4)\) 的中心热图，物体的投影 3D 中心在其类别通道上是一个经高斯溅射的亮斑；
- **回归只在中心学**：一张 8 通道回归图，只在热图峰值位置被读取。

其 8 维回归布局与 FCOS3D 的 9 维不同，且深度放在第 0 维：

| 通道 | 维数 | 物理含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | 深度偏移（围绕先验） |
| 1–2 | 2 | 投影中心的像素偏移 |
| 3–5 | 3 | 尺寸偏移（log 空间，围绕类别均值） |
| 6–7 | 2 | 局部朝向的单位向量（sin, cos 二维） |

与 FCOS3D 的对照：朝向从「标量 + 方向二分类」变成「二维单位向量」；无 centerness、无方向分类、无属性；特征只用 DLA neck 的一层 4 倍下采样图（无 FPN 多层）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

训练：

```text
DLANet → DLANeck → 单层 64 通道特征 (B, 64, H/4, W/4)
  │ forward_single：cls热图分支 / 8通道回归分支
  │   cls: sigmoid + clamp(1e-4, 1-1e-4)          ← 激活内嵌在前向里
  │   dim 通道: sigmoid() - 0.5                   ← 尺寸偏移对称化
  │   ori 通道: F.normalize                        ← 单位向量
  ▼
get_targets：gt 投影中心 ×(1/4) 溅射到热图（半径由 2D 框缩放后的高斯半径决定）
get_predictions：在 gt 中心位置 gather 回归 → SMOKECoder.decode → 三组「半真半预测」框
loss：GaussianFocalLoss(热图) + L1(三组框的 8 个角点)
```

推理：

```text
热图 → 3×3 局部极大值 → topK=100 峰值
  → 峰值处 gather 8 维回归 → SMOKECoder.decode（反 trans_mat + 乘深度 + 反内参）
  → score > 0.25 过滤 → CameraInstance3DBoxes(origin=(0.5,0.5,0.5))
（无 NMS：局部极大值 + 每峰一框天然去重）
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

配置先行：

[configs/_base_/models/smoke.py:L25-L61](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/configs/_base_/models/smoke.py#L25-L61) —— `dim_channel=[3,4,5]`、`ori_channel=[6,7]` 声明 8 维回归中尺寸/朝向占据的通道（L29-30）；`group_reg_dims=(8,)` 单组（L39）；`bbox_code_size=7`（KITTI 无速度，L43）；`bbox_coder=dict(type='SMOKECoder', base_depth=(28.01, 16.32), base_dims=...)`（L46-51）——先验直接写在配置里：28.01/16.32 是 KITTI 训练集深度的均值/标准差，`base_dims` 是车/行人/骑车人三类的平均 \((l, h, w)\)。`train_cfg=None`（L60）、`test_cfg` 只有 `topK=100` 与 `local_maximum_kernel=3`（L61）——没有 NMS 参数。

前向内嵌激活：

[mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py:L102-L121](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L102-L121) —— 调父类 `forward_single` 拿裸输出后：cls 热图先 sigmoid 再 clamp 到 \([10^{-4}, 1-10^{-4}]\)（L113-114，防 log(0) 与梯度饱和）；`dim_channel` 三通道过 `sigmoid() - 0.5`（L116-117，把乘性尺寸偏移的中心移到 0，对应解码时的 `exp`）；`ori_channel` 两通道做 `F.normalize`（L119-120，约束成单位向量——方向只关心指向不关心幅度）。对比 FCOS3D：这些激活全部推迟到推理/损失里，SMOKE 则直接焊在 forward 上，因此它训练与推理读到的回归图永远是「已激活」的。

热图目标：

[mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py:L394-L421](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L394-L421) —— 特征图是原图的 1/4（L394-395），gt 投影中心乘 `width_ratio` 投到特征图；对每个 gt 取其 2D 框缩放后的高斯半径（`min_overlap=0.7`，L414-415），在对应类别通道上溅射高斯（L418-419）；`avg_factor = max(1, 热图上值为 1 的像素数)`（L421）作为 GaussianFocalLoss 的归一。这两个高斯工具（`gaussian_radius`/`gen_gaussian_target`）直接从 mmdet 借用——与 u5-l5 CenterPoint 在 BEV 上做热图是同一套代码资产。

推理解码：

[mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py:L149-L180](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L149-L180) —— L149 断言只有单层输出；L150-157 从 metainfo 堆叠 `cam2img` 与 `trans_mat`；L158-165 调 `_decode_heatmap(topk=100, kernel=3)`；L174-177 只保留 `score > 0.25` 的框；L179-180 用 `box_type_3d` 以几何中心 origin 包装。`_decode_heatmap` 内部（[L235-L251](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L235-L251)）：3×3 局部极大值（L235）→ topK（L237-239）→ 峰值处 gather 8 维回归（L241-242）→ `bbox_coder.decode`（L247-248）→ 拼成 (B, 100, 7)。

`trans_mat` 从哪来？SMOKE 专属管线里有 [RandomShiftScale 与 AffineResize](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/configs/smoke/smoke_dla34_dlaneck_gn-all_4xb8-6x_kitti-mono3d.py#L18-L20)（随机平移缩放 + 仿射 resize 到 1280×384），这两个 transform 会把 `trans_mat`（原图→特征图的仿射矩阵）与 `affine_aug` 标志写进结果字典（[transforms_3d.py:L1662](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/datasets/transforms/transforms_3d.py#L1662) 起）——2D 仿射会破坏 3D 标定关系，必须记录矩阵以便解码时还原。

SMOKECoder 的解码几何：

[mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py:L96-L112](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L96-L112) —— `decode` 把 8 维切成 depth/offset/dim/ori 四段，依次得到深度、投影中心、尺寸、朝向。

[mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py:L114-L119](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L114-L119) —— 深度线性反归一：\(d = o_d \times 16.32 + 28.01\)，即配置里那对先验。

[mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py:L148-L161](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L148-L161) —— 求中心的解析反投影：特征图点加偏移 → 齐次坐标左乘 `trans_mat` 的逆回到原图像素 → **乘上深度**（把归一化坐标变成 \( (u d, v d, d) \)）→ 左乘 `cam2img` 的逆 → 相机系 3D 中心。这与 4.3.4 手推的几何完全同构，只是多了「特征图 ↔ 原图」的仿射一层。

[mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py:L163-L177](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L163-L177) —— 尺寸：\(dims = e^{o} \cdot \bar{dims}_{label}\)，乘性围绕类别均值。[L179-L217](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/task_modules/coders/smoke_bbox_coder.py#L179-L217) —— 朝向：由单位向量算夹角 \(\alpha = \arctan(\sin/(\cos+\epsilon))\)，按 cos 分量符号做 ±π/2 象限修正，再加视线角 \(ray = \arctan(X/Z)\)（用刚解出的中心位置）得全局 yaw，最后折叠回 \([-\pi, \pi]\)——与 FCOS3D 的 `decode_yaw` 目的相同，但用二维向量替代「标量 + 二分类」。

训练侧的三组 corner 损失：

[mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py:L302-L323](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L302-L323) —— `get_predictions` 在 **gt 投影中心**处 gather 回归预测并解码；L309 `locations[:, 1] += dimensions[:, 1] / 2` 把几何中心换到底面中心（配合 `encode` 用 `box_type_3d` 默认底面 origin 包装）；L316-321 构造三组「替换一个成分、其余用真值」的框——预测朝向的 `bbox3d_yaws`、预测尺寸的 `bbox3d_dims`、预测位置的 `bbox3d_locs`。

[mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py:L533-L552](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L533-L552) —— 损失 = GaussianFocalLoss（热图）+ 三组框各自 `.corners`（每框 8 个三维角点）对真值角点的 L1 之和。用角点而非裸参数算损失，是把「位置、尺寸、朝向」三个异质量纲的误差统一到同一几何空间的手法（u6-l4 Part-A2 的 corner loss 同源）。另注意 [L385-L389](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/smoke_mono3d_head.py#L385-L389)：经历过 `RandomShiftScale` 仿射增强（`affine_aug=True`）的样本不计回归损失——2D 仿射后 3D 真值不再可靠，只保留热图监督。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：SMOKE 推理为什么可以不做 NMS？

**答案**：检出方式是热图上的 3×3 局部极大值 + 每峰只取一个框：同一物体的邻域像素在局部极大值筛选后只剩峰值本身，不同物体峰不重合，天然互斥。FCOS3D 每个像素都出框，邻域像素对同一物体的预测高度冗余，必须用旋转 NMS 去重。

**练习 2**：SMOKE 的朝向为什么用二维单位向量，而不是 FCOS3D 的「标量 + 方向二分类」？

**答案**：二维 \((\sin, \cos)\) 表示天然消除了 \(2\pi\) 周期与 ±π 不连续问题（角度回绕在单位圆上连续），不需要额外的方向分类分支；代价是解码时要处理象限（`_decode_orientation` 的 ±π/2 修正）。两种方案解决同一个问题，是同一权衡的不同取舍——u5-l7 的 MultiBin、u5-l4 的 sin 差回归也都是这个家族的成员。

**练习 3**：`trans_mat` 在 SMOKE 里必不可少，在 FCOS3D 里却没有，为什么？

**答案**：SMOKE 的管线含 `RandomShiftScale`/`AffineResize` 仿射增强，特征图坐标与原图像素之间隔着一张仿射矩阵，解码时必须先乘 `trans_mat` 逆还原；FCOS3D 的测试管线只有 `mmdet.Resize`（等比缩放，比例信息在 `scale_factor` 里，见 [fcos_mono3d_head.py:L658-L659](https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmdetection3d/blob/fe25f7a51d36e3702f961e198894580d83c4387b/mmdet3d/models/dense_heads/fcos_mono3d_head.py#L658-L659) 的处理），不需要完整仿射矩阵。解码器与数据管线是配套设计的。

1. 准备脚本（示例代码，保存为 `fcos3d_head_probe.py`，在仓库根目录运行）：

```python
# 示例代码：探针 FCOSMono3DHead 的分支形状与解码几何
import torch
from mmengine import Config, init_default_scope

init_default_scope('mmdet3d')          # 让 type='FCOSMono3DHead' 能路由（u4-l1）
from mmdet3d.registry import MODELS    # locations 懒导入会自动加载 mmdet3d.models
from mmdet3d.structures import points_cam2img, points_img2cam

cfg = Config.fromfile(
    'configs/fcos3d/fcos3d_r101-caffe-dcn_fpn_head-gn_8xb2-1x_nus-mono3d.py')

head = MODELS.build(cfg.model.bbox_head)
head.eval()

# 模拟 1600x900 输入（pad 到 32 的倍数）经 FPN 后的 5 层特征
sizes = (113, 57, 29, 15, 8)   # strides = [8, 16, 32, 64, 128]
feats = tuple(torch.randn(1, 256, h, w) for h, w in
              zip(sizes, sizes))  # 方形仅为演示

with torch.no_grad():
    outs = head(feats)
cls_scores, bbox_preds, dir_preds, attr_preds, centernesses = outs[:5]

print('分支形状（每层）:')
for name, o in zip(['cls(10)', 'bbox(9)', 'dir(2)', 'attr(9)', 'centerness(1)'],
                   [cls_scores, bbox_preds, dir_preds, attr_preds, centernesses]):
    print(f'  {name:>14}: {[tuple(t.shape) for t in o]}')

# ---- 解码几何：取第 0 层（stride=8）某格点 ----
level, stride = 0, head.strides[level]
bbox = bbox_preds[level][0]        # (9, H, W)，forward 内已做过 decode
i, j = sizes[level] // 2, sizes[level] // 2   # 中心格点

offset = bbox[:2, i, j]            # 已乘 stride 的像素偏移（eval 模式）
depth  = bbox[2, i, j]             # exp 后的米制深度
w, h, l = bbox[3:6, i, j]          # exp 后的米制尺寸（CAM 系: 宽/高/长）

# 格点中心像素坐标（对照 _get_points_single 的公式）
pt = torch.tensor([j * stride + stride // 2, i * stride + stride // 2],
                  dtype=torch.float32)
center2d = pt - offset             # 投影 3D 中心的像素坐标 (u, v)
p25d = torch.cat([center2d, depth[None]])       # (u, v, d)

# 2.5D → 相机系 → 再投影回像素（往返验证）
cam_pt = points_img2cam(p25d[None, :])[0]       # (X, Y, Z)
reproj = points_cam2img(cam_pt[None, :])[0]     # (u', v')

# 内参（量级取自 nuScenes CAM_FRONT0）
view = torch.tensor([[1266.4, 0, 816.2], [0, 870.2, 493.9], [0, 0, 1]])

print(f'\ndepth={depth:.2f} m, dims(w,h,l)=({w:.2f},{h:.2f},{l:.2f}) m')
print(f'center2d={center2d.tolist()}, cam={cam_pt.tolist()}')
print(f'往返误差: {float((reproj - center2d).abs().max()):.2e} px')

# 2D 框合理性：像素宽 ≈ fx*w/Z，像素高 ≈ fy*h/Z
fx, fy = view[0, 0], view[1, 1]
print(f'投影 2D 框尺寸估计: 宽 {float(fx*w/cam_pt[2]):.1f} px, '
      f'高 {float(fy*h/cam_pt[2]):.1f} px')
```

2. 确认环境里已按 [u1-l2](u1-l2-installation-and-verification.md) 装好 mmengine/mmcv/mmdet/mmdet3d，然后运行 `python fcos3d_head_probe.py`。

**需要观察的现象**：

1. 五个分支每层形状分别为 `(1, 10, H, W)`、`(1, 9, H, W)`、`(1, 2, H, W)`、`(1, 9, H, W)`、`(1, 1, H, W)`——与 4.2.4 的纸面表格逐一对上；`bbox_pred` 已是**解码后**的量（深度为正的米制值）。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
